name.en: A personal page from the public anamnesis

description.en: Writes a one-page personal site about the owner from the records of the anamnesis that the owner confirmed and marked public (nothing private or sensitive is read), checks that it carries no link or address the facts do not have, and saves it as a file in the project. Nothing is published.
description.ru: Пишет одностраничный сайт-визитку о владельце из записей анамнеза, которые владелец подтвердил и пометил публичными (приватное и чувствительное не читается), сверяет, что в нём нет ссылок и адресов, которых нет в фактах, и сохраняет файлом в проекте. Ничего не публикуется.

ru: Сделай сайт-визитку обо мне из публичных записей анамнеза
Собери страницу «обо мне» из того, что я пометил публичным в анамнезе
Нужна визитка-лендинг про меня по анамнезу, только публичное
en: Make a personal about-me page from my public anamnesis records
Build my business-card site from what I marked public in the anamnesis

not_for: copywriting of a client's site (use copy-lead)

notes.note: what to stress; never a source of facts

quality_mode.effect: not used: there are no code tasks

machines: the owner's Mac mini: the anamnesis store (~/.lane-pilot/anamnesis) is read through the host

nodes.rule: code: the owner's records that are confirmed AND marked public, nothing else; drafts, candidates, private and sensitive records never leave the Mac mini

nodes.prompt: Write the owner's personal one-page site as ONE self-contained HTML file: inline CSS, no scripts, no external fonts, images or trackers, readable at 375 px and at 1280 px. A short heading and a line about who they are, then the parts the facts support (skills, projects, interests, tools), calm and factual, no superlatives that the facts do not give. Sources: ONLY `facts_text`: records the owner confirmed and marked public. Nothing else is a source: not your memory of the owner, not this chat, not `notes` (`notes` only says what to stress). Do not invent employers, dates, numbers, places, links or e-mail addresses; every link or address you write must stand in the facts. A part with no facts is left out, not filled. Language: `language` (ru or en). If `fix` is given, a check of your earlier text failed: correct exactly those violations. Put the whole text in `artifact`.

title.en: Check what was written against the facts

nodes.rule: code: not empty, within the size limit, no link or e-mail address that the facts do not contain, no draft mark

map.reason: 'no record is both confirmed and marked public: open the Anamnesis tab, confirm what is right and mark what may be shown as public'
'the text did not pass the check against the public facts twice (a link, address or mark that is not in the facts)'

test.live: on the owner's real records: mark two or three records public in the Anamnesis tab, run the chain, open the file at the reported path in a browser at 375 and 1280 px and compare every statement with the public records; then check that nothing from a private record is on the page.
